# Genius Puzzles

> > A comprehensive collection of brain-teasers, riddles, and logic puzzles designed to challenge and entertain problem-solvers of all levels.

Genius Puzzles is a dedicated platform offering thousands of puzzles across multiple categories including logic, mathematics, lateral thinking, and visual challenges. The site serves both casual puzzle enthusiasts and competitive exam candidates with curated collections of brain-teasers, riddles, and mind-teasers.

## Core Puzzle Categories

- [Logic Puzzles And Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/logic-puzzles-and-riddles): Logic puzzles and mind-teasers featuring lateral thinking games.
- [Maths Puzzles And Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/maths-puzzles-and-riddles): Maths puzzles with number problems, probability and brain-teasers.
- [Mystery Puzzle And Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/mystery-puzzles-and-riddles): Mystery puzzles including detective logic and murder mysteries.
- [Popular Puzzles And Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/popular-puzzles-and-riddles): Popular puzzle collection with mystery and picture-based brain-teasers.

## Specialized Puzzle Types

- [Story Puzzles And Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/story-puzzles-riddles-teasers): Story-based puzzles with logical deduction and mystery riddles.
- [Situation Puzzles And Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/situation-puzzles-riddles): Situation puzzles requiring lateral thinking and brain-teasing logic.
- [Rebus Puzzles And Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/rebus-puzzles-riddles): Rebus and pictogram visual puzzles with word-based logic games.
- [Picture Brain Teasers And Answers](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/picture-brain-teasers): Picture brain-teasers with visual puzzles and spot-the-mistake challenges.
- [Cipher Puzzles And Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/cipher-puzzles-and-riddles): Cipher puzzles, code-breaking riddles and cryptography challenges.

## Mathematical & Analytical Puzzles

- [Probability Questions And Answers](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/probability-questions-answers): Probability puzzles and math brain-teasers including dice and lottery problems.
- [Math Equation Puzzles And Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/math-equation-puzzles-riddles): Math equation puzzles with number series and viral brain-teasers.
- [Number Series](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/number-series): Number series with pattern recognition and IQ test sequence puzzles.
- [Time Distance Puzzles/Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/time-distance-puzzles-riddles-teasers): Time-distance puzzles and speed-distance-time math brain-teasers.

## Word & Trick Puzzles

- [Trivia Puzzles Questions And Answers](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/trivia-puzzles-questions-answers): Trivia puzzles with trick questions, math riddles and word puzzles.
- [Good Trick Questions](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/good-trick-questions): Trick questions and lateral-thinking riddles for mind-teasers.
- [Funny Puzzles And Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/funny-puzzles-and-riddles): Funny puzzles with humor, word-play and entertaining brain-teasers.

## Educational & Exam Preparation

- [IAS Interview Questions](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/ias-interview-questions): IAS interview prep with logic puzzles and civil service exam questions.
- [Science Riddles And Puzzles](https://gpuzzles.com/brain-questions/science-riddles-puzzles): Science riddles and physics puzzles for educational problem-solving.

## Getting Started

- [Genius Puzzles and Riddles](https://gpuzzles.com): Homepage for Genius Puzzles, a collection of brain-teasers and riddles.
